title: Green Fee-Free Account Referral Program
summary: Explains the Rho-Bank Green Fee-Free Account Referral Program: referrers earn $20 per successful referral, and new members receive a $35 welcome bonus. Up to 4 referrals/year qualify, provided the new member deposits at least $300 within 60 days and the referrer has a 30-day checking relationship.
